sources.title: Multimodal Intelligence Lab - UW Departments Web Server
sources.snippet: Multimodal Intelligence Lab (MILab) The Multimodal Intelligence Lab (MILab) is a University of Washington research group based at UW Tacoma. We develop multimodal AI systems that connect perception, language, memory, reasoning, and action. Our work spans foundation models, embodied agents, robotics, mobility intelligence, public safety, and human-centered decision support.
